issues.text: The state after F1, for ORCH and the launches F1k and F1e: every entry of TEXTS holds only its ru value (row F1 «every key of 4.1, ru values»); F1k adds kk and F1e adds en (row F1k, F1e). Until F1e lands, 4.1's shape {ru, kk, en} and «every value a non-empty string in the three languages» (TX-1, TX-2, criterion 2) do not hold yet; no step reads kk or en before then (B2 after F1e and F2e, B5 later, T2 at step 5). The kk and en values that records fix: theme_auto, theme_light, theme_dark kk «Авто», «Ашық», «Қараңғы», en «Auto», «Light», «Dark» (decisions/0084 §3 item 15); theme_name kk «Тақырып», en «Theme» (decisions/0123 I4); lang_ru «RU», lang_kk «ҚАЗ», lang_en «EN» the same in the three languages (4.1); brand_name «Sai» and brand_tile «S» as written (4.1).

Rules met in ru that the later launches keep (for F1k, F1e, F2 and F6): (a) criterion 9 (c), PB-1: an order_ value must not stand as a whole word or phrase in a kept value or a kept file of the public set unless a kept key has that value; in ru none does, and order_cannot_1, _3, _4, _5 equal nobuild_1, _4, _8, _5 on purpose (a shorter «Настоящая отправка писем и сообщений» would stand inside nobuild_4). The short order values are the ones to watch in kk, en and the static pages: «Лендинг», «Каталог», «Калькулятор», «Пример запроса», «Что вы получите», «Что не входит», «Что можно заказать», «Примеры запросов». (b) order_example_N_kind is «a solution name of the intake» (4.1): «Лендинг», «Каталог» and «Калькулятор» name the intake's solutions landing, catalog and calculator, so F2 gives those three solutions the same ru names (or changes both files in one sub-step). (c) No kept value but the fixed test-mode line holds the stem «заказ» and none names a price or a term (G8 «б», the readers' marks of criterion 2). (d) demo_not_fit holds no word of «Чего Sai пока не делает» (look 7.14; issue I3).

Look 7.14 gives «Не подойдёт, если» as an example of the heading of the not_suitable_when list and in the same sentence rules that the heading «holds no word of the fixed heading below» («Чего Sai пока не делает»); «не» is a word of both. The rule was followed: demo_not_fit «Лучше другое решение, если». No departure from the code design (the wording is the texts module's); a point for the look edit of decisions/0123 J3, J5, J7 or for the readers.

Look 13.3 gives the «<enough…>» budget as «two lines in 150 px at 14/900 below 760», but the sample sets `* { box-sizing: border-box; }` (styles.css:11) and `.ticket .enough { padding: 0 10px; max-width: 150px }` (styles.css:319), so the text room is 130 px; the sample's own «Хватит, покажите результат» takes 3 lines in 130 px (measured). demo_enough «Хватит, к результату» meets both readings (2 lines in 130 px and in 150 px; 175.6 px at 16/900 ≤ 238.5). A point for the look edit.

A slip of the tool, undone at once (a candidate for the error journal, Q13): the file-writing tool of this session turned the escape text backslash-u-2028 and backslash-u-2029 of text-rules.js into the raw characters U+2028 and U+2029, which end a line inside the regular expression literal; prettier --check found the syntax error, a byte replacement restored the escape text, and the FORBIDDEN line is now byte-equal to the picker's (diff). The same tool turned seven escapes of the driver outside the project into raw characters; restored the same way before the driver ran. The lesson: after writing a file whose code holds backslash-u escapes, compare its bytes or its code lines with the source (od, a code diff) before any check.
